ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law No. 80 of 2002 on Combating Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing, as amended by Law No. 36 of 2014 and Law No. 22 of 2016, together with its Executive Regulations and the binding instructions issued by the Egyptian Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Combating Unit (EMLCU) and the Central Bank of Egypt; Law No. 72 of 2017 on Investment and its Executive Regulations, including beneficial-owner declaration requirements; Law No. 159 of 1981 on Companies; and the Financial Regulatory Authority's Beneficial Owner Register Rules.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing (or Certificate of Corporate Existence) of each foreign corporate shareholder and UBO entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent corporate registry in the shareholder's jurisdiction of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization by the Egyptian Embassy/Consulate in the issuing country; an Apostille is acceptable only if the issuing State and Egypt are both Contracting Parties to the 1961 Hague Convention

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of the Memorandum and Articles of Association (constitutive documents) of each foreign corporate shareholder and UBO entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies Registry and/or authenticating chamber of commerce in the shareholder's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization by the Egyptian Embassy/Consulate; conditional Hague Apostille where both jurisdictions are 1961 Convention Contracting Parties

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Original board resolution approving the incorporation of the Egyptian LLC, appointing the local manager, and authorizing the corporate signatory
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Foreign shareholder's board of directors, with signatures notarized by a notary public and legalized by the relevant foreign ministry
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization by the Egyptian Embassy/Consulate; conditional Hague Apostille where both jurisdictions are 1961 Convention Contracting Parties

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Duly executed Power of Attorney to the Egyptian incorporation attorney or registered agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the principal's jurisdiction and the competent foreign ministry/consulate
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization by the Egyptian Embassy/Consulate; conditional Hague Apostille where both jurisdictions are 1961 Convention Contracting Parties

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Valid identity documents (passport copies) of all shareholders, directors, authorized signatories, and ultimate beneficial owners
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing government authority or certified copy prepared by a notary or embassy
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized or consular attestation; passport copies do not require apostille when accompanied by a notarized certification

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Companies Law No. 159 of 1981, as amended by Law No. 94 of 2005, Law No. 17 of 2013 and Law No. 3 of 2016, Articles 34–74 (Limited Liability Companies); Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 and its Executive Regulations; Commercial Registry Regulations under the Ministry of Trade decrees.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) — One-Stop Shop (OSS), Commercial Registry Department, Cairo.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Notarized Articles of Association (Aqd Al-Taasis / النظام الأساسي) together with the official GAFI Incorporation Application Form.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital is imposed on a service LLC under Law No. 159 of 1981; the declared capital must be adequate for the virtual CFO activity and is commonly set at not less than EGP 50,000. At notarization, at least 25% of the cash share capital must be deposited in a provisional escrow bank account at a licensed Egyptian bank, and the bank-issued capital deposit certificate must be submitted to GAFI. The escrowed funds are released only upon issuance of commercial registration.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION — EG_LLC (virtual CFO services). RESOLVED, that the registered capital and the subscription of the partners as declared in the Articles of Association are hereby ratified and accepted. RESOLVED, that the registered office at [address], Cairo, Egypt is adopted as the principal legal seat of the company. RESOLVED, that the Managing Director, the Chief Financial Officer, and the Corporate Secretary are appointed for the first fiscal year. RESOLVED, that the officers are authorized to complete GAFI commercial registration, tax card issuance, social insurance registration, bank account opening, and execution of the office lease and license documents. RESOLVED, that the Corporate Secretary shall maintain the statutory register and file all declarations under Law 159/1981.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Reservation and Economic Activity Classification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI One-Stop Shop (OSS) — Name Reservation Window, Cairo, via GAFI online portal (www.gafi.gov.eg)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the GAFI incorporation questionnaire designating the LLC type, the ISIC 6920 activity described as 'accounting, bookkeeping, auditing and tax consultancy — outsourced virtual CFO services', proposed corporate names in Arabic and English, partner nationalities and the declared capital. GAFI performs a conflict and similarity check against the Commercial Registry database and issues a name reservation certificate valid for 30 days.
required_dossiers: Completed GAFI incorporation application (Form 1)
List of up to three proposed company names
Copies of passports or national IDs of all founding partners and intended managers
Arabic activity description and target services scope
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected for similarity or contains a prohibited term, resubmit with normalized alternatives or lodge an administrative objection with the GAFI Name Reservation Committee; a revised reservation is usually re-issued within one working day.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Provisional Bank Account Opening and Paid-up Capital Deposit
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Egyptian commercial bank through the GAFI OSS integrated bank desk (e.g. National Bank of Egypt, Banque Misr, Commercial International Bank)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a provisional under-incorporation escrow account in the intended company name; deposit at least 25% of the cash share capital declared in the draft Articles of Association; obtain an official capital deposit certificate stamped by the bank manager for presentation to the notary and GAFI.
required_dossiers: GAFI name reservation certificate
Draft Articles of Association signed by all partners
Passport or ID copies of all signatories
Pro-forma first board resolution authorizing the deposit
Beneficial ownership declaration for AML and KYC compliance
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank queries the corporate name or demands additional KYC documentation, remedy by providing utility bills, clearing source of funds, or executing an amended declaration; the capital deposit certificate is then re-issued. No part of the escrow is released prior to commercial registration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization of the Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Egyptian Notary Public Authority (Al-Shahr Al-Aqari) through the GAFI OSS integrated notary office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the draft Articles of Association, capital deposit certificate, name reservation certificate and partner IDs before the notary public. Pay the statutory notary tax (Safqa) and stamp duties. All shareholders must sign in person or through an authenticated power of attorney. The notary endorses the Aqd Al-Taasis and issues the notarized deed for commercial registration.
required_dossiers: Notarial incorporation deed in Arabic, draft plus three certified copies
Capital deposit certificate issued by the escrow bank
GAFI name reservation certificate
Valid passports or IDs of all founding partners
Receipts of notary fees and stamp duty payments
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary requires amendment to the ownership transfer restrictions or object clauses, the partners execute a notarial addendum and the corrected deed is re-issued within one to two working days without renewal of the name reservation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: GAFI Commercial Registration and Tax Card Issuance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI One-Stop Shop — Commercial Registry Division and Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) integrated desk
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the notarized Articles of Association with the GAFI OSS; pay the incorporation and commercial registration fees; GAFI registers the company in the Commercial Registry (Sijill Tijari) and simultaneously activates the corporate tax card (TIN) through the integrated ETA desk. The company thereby becomes a juridical person on the national commercial and tax rolls.
required_dossiers: Notarized Articles of Association (Aqd Al-Taasis)
First board resolution appointing the officers
Lease contract or title document of the registered office
Capital deposit certificate and bank release letter
Passport or ID copies of the managers and the CFO consultant
Proof of registered-office address, such as a utility bill or notarized lease
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If GAFI queries the lease cadastre number or any board resolution, remedy by submitting a corrected lease certificate and a supplemental board resolution; the OSS may grant conditional registration while the supplement is under review.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Social Insurance Registration of the Entity
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Organization for Social Insurance (NOSI) — Al-Hay'a Al-Qawmiya Lil Ta'min Al-Ijtima'i, office of the registered-office jurisdiction
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the company and its Egyptian resident managers and employees with NOSI within 60 days from commercial registration. Submit Form No. 1 (establishment declaration) and Form No. 2 (insured persons and salaries list). Upon acceptance, the company receives its insurance policy number and contribution schedule, which the ETA will cross-reference in wage declarations.
required_dossiers: Commercial Register extract
Tax card (TIN certificate)
Form No. 1 — establishment registration declaration
Form No. 2 — insured persons and salary list
Management contracts or labor contracts of employees
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Late registration penalties can be mitigated by filing the forms within the grace period with stamped receipts; any discrepancy is cured by submitting an amended Form No. 2 and salary certification from the statutory auditor.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Chamber of Commerce Membership and GAFI Operating License
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cairo Chamber of Commerce under the Federation of Egyptian Chambers of Commerce, and GAFI Investment Licensing Department
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the Commercial Register extract to the competent Chamber of Commerce, pay the annual membership fee assessed on the LLC's authorized capital bracket and obtain the chamber certificate. In parallel, file with GAFI for the operating license (Rokhsat Tashghil) for the virtual CFO office, attaching the lease, tax card, social insurance number, Civil Defense clearance, EEAA registration receipt and the board resolution. GAFI then issues the final operation license enabling commencement of revenue-generating services.
required_dossiers: Commercial Register extract and tax card
Notarized office lease contract
Civil Defense fire safety and occupancy clearance
EEAA environmental registration receipt (Category C office use)
Board resolution applying for the operating license
Chamber of Commerce membership certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If GAFI conditions the operating license on additional occupancy documentation or the local municipal trade permit, the company may obtain an interim provisional license while the deficiency is corrected; an administrative appeal is available before the GAFI Investment Complaints Committee.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: GAFI Investment Licensing Department, in coordination with the Local Administrative Trade Licensing Unit (District/Hayy Office) and the Ministry of Interior's General Administration of Civil Defense.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: GAFI Operating License (Rokhsat Tashghil) and Municipal Office Activity License (Rokhsat al-Mahall) for professional accounting, bookkeeping and fractional CFO advisory services.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Egyptian Environmental Affairs Agency (EEAA) — Ministry of Environment
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category C (Registration/Exempt): office-based virtual CFO services do not trigger a full environmental impact assessment under Law No. 4 of 1994; only simple environmental registration is required. If the company installs backup generators or a dedicated server room, a Category B screening report may become mandatory.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Domestic wastewater to the public sewer must comply with Law 93 of 1962 and the Executive Regulations of Law 4 of 1994 (BOD not exceeding 350 mg/L and TSS not exceeding 200 mg/L). VOC emissions from office cleaning agents remain negligible. Electronic and paper waste must be directed through authorized municipal waste streams. Any installed backup generator must respect ambient noise limits of 60 dB(A) in commercial zones and the exhaust emission limits of Ministerial Decree No. 338 of 1995 under Law 4 of 1994.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Civil Defense fire safety clearance requires certification of fire extinguishers, an alarm and evacuation plan, and the fire-load classification of the office floor. A structural load inspection certificate must confirm the open-plan workstation occupancy load. The Ministry of Manpower issues the workplace occupational safety and health clearance covering ergonomic and electrical safety. All clearances must be attached to the GAFI operating license application file.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA), headquartered in Cairo; official self-service gateways are the Egypt Tax e-Services Portal (https://www.incometax.gov.eg) and the Tax E-Invoicing / E-Receipt Platforms (https://einvoicing.invoicing.gov.eg).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned Egyptian LLC must first complete commercial registration (Commercial Register) and investor file creation at the General Authority for Investment (GAFI) one-stop shop. Thereafter the Egyptian Tax Authority issues a unified Tax Card (بطاقة ضريبية) and TIN through the e-Services Portal. Required file documents include the Certificate of Incorporation, Articles of Association (Mourid), board resolution appointing a statutory tax representative, proof of registered office in Egypt or a service address for a pure virtual operation, notarized power of attorney (consularized if executed abroad), and bank confirmation of the Egyptian collection account. Non-resident service suppliers without an Egyptian establishment may obtain simplified VAT TIN registration directly with the ETA non-resident desk for e-invoicing compliance.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Egyptian Tax Law No. 91/2005 and VAT Law No. 67/2016 do not provide a check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch pass-through election. An LLC is mandatorily subject to entity-level corporate income tax on its Egyptian taxable income. Available statutory elections include: (i) formation of a consolidated Egyptian tax group between a parent entity and subsidiaries in which it holds at least 95% shareholding, upon joint application; (ii) election of the simplified approximate VAT / small taxpayer regime where annual turnover falls below the statutory bands; and (iii) election to offset measurable input VAT credits against VAT liabilities or to claim a cash refund where credits exceed the output tax in any tax period.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT — Egyptian Value Added Tax (Law No. 67 of 2016, as amended, and its Executive Regulations)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Mandatory VAT registration applies where annual taxable supplies exceed EGP 500,000; voluntary registration is permitted from EGP 250,000. Non-resident suppliers of digitally supplied or remote consultancy services to non-registered Egyptian recipients are required to register and self-assess VAT through the ETA simplified non-resident procedure once a digital nexus is established, irrespective of turnover thresholds.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Egypt enforces a mandatory pre-clearance fiscal e-invoicing and e-receipt regime administered by the ETA. Invoices must be generated in XML/JSON through an ETA-approved API integration and transmitted for real-time validation before issuance; each compliant invoice receives a unique UUID, cryptographic hash, and a digital QR stamp. All taxpayers above the ETA inclusion thresholds must integrate their ERP, billing, or cloud-based hosted billing engine with the ETA platform. For the Virtual CFO consultancy, the LLC's billing module (including Stripe and Wise invoicing rails) must therefore emit ETA-stamped zero-rated or standard-rated invoices. Non-integration or issuance of unstamped invoices attracts a statutory fine of at least EGP 50,000 per offense, and the buyer cannot deduct the input VAT in its ledger.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: A 0% rate applies to exported goods physically leaving Egypt and to exported services supplied to a non-resident recipient who has no permanent establishment in Egypt, provided the service is wholly consumed offshore. Fractional CFO advisory and multicurrency ledger bookkeeping will qualify as zero-rated offshore services where the engagement contract is executed with a foreign corporate client, services are performed outside Egypt's economic territory, consideration is received in foreign convertible currency through an authorized payment rail, and the invoice is serialized on the ETA e-invoicing portal as an export transaction. Any service component benefiting an Egyptian establishment or connected to domestic clients remains taxable at 14%.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs export declaration (ACID) with Egyptian Customs Authority approval and export receipt codes
Bill of Lading, Airway Bill, or international CMR evidencing Egyptian point of export and offshore destination
ETA-stamped zero-rated tax invoice containing the valid UUID, hash, and QR code
Signed commercial services contract with the non-resident client
Inward remittance certificate issued by an Egyptian bank or foreign-exchange warrant from the Central Bank of Egypt evidencing collection of export consideration in hard currency
Accounting ledger reconciliation confirming full recognition of the offshore revenue against the payment rail settlement
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The ETA may audit zero-rated export substantiation within a five-year assessment window, with an unlimited period in fraud cases. A claim missing any element of the documentation bundle is clawed back in full: the 14% VAT is re-assessed from the invoice date, together with delay interest at 2% per month or part thereof on the unpaid tax. Deliberate fabrication of export evidence exposes the LLC to criminal tax evasion sanctions of imprisonment of at least three years and/or a fine of EGP 5,000-250,000, plus a civil penalty equal to 100% of the evaded VAT, bank account freeze, and asset attachment. Central Bank of Egypt currency-control violations additionally suspend outward remittance entitlements, revoke the Annual Account number, and disqualify the taxpayer from future VAT refund offsets until the irregularity is cured.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Egypt (CBE) - the unified monetary authority and foreign exchange regulator under Law No. 194 of 2020, with primary rulemaking power over banking operations, FX transfers, capital account transactions, and cross-border liquidity requirements.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Egypt operates a managed floating exchange-rate regime following the 2016 liberalization reflected in CBE Circular No. 1 of 2017, as amended. Current-account transactions such as service fees, profit remittances, and dividends are generally convertible through licensed banks upon presentation of valid underlying documentation. Capital-account inflows and outflows require CBE registration and are assessed against systemic foreign-currency liquidity. Profit remittance by a wholly foreign-owned Egyptian LLC is permissible but requires filed audited financial statements, a valid tax clearance certificate, payment of dividend withholding tax at the applicable rate, and CBE Form A documentation; foreign-currency scarcity can cause timing delays during periodic FX shocks and CBE rationing.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under CBE rules, export proceeds must be received into an Egyptian-bank foreign-currency account within 90 days from the date of customs shipment (extendable to 180 days with prior CBE approval), supported by the customs export declaration and bank receipt voucher. No mandatory percentage conversion or surrender to the central bank has applied since the 2016 exchange-rate float; exporters may freely retain proceeds in foreign currency in onshore accounts and sell to the banking system at negotiated commercial rates.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of Alexandria S.A.E. (Intesa Sanpaolo Group)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Moderate only as a collection front-end. Offshore digital EMIs such as Wise and Stripe can serve as payment-intake channels for invoicing overseas clients, but CBE exchange-control rules require all FX service receipts to be returned to a bank account at a licensed Egyptian bank. The compliant blueprint is EMI collection followed by periodic SWIFT MT103 settlement into the LLC's Egyptian escrow or operational account, never a pure offshore treasury halt.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: In-person presence is mandatory for the resident legal representative and, in most leading Egyptian banks, for every non-resident director/shareholder opening a foreign-currency account. Fully remote account opening is not accepted at mainstream Tier-1 banks. A practical and accepted alternative is a notarized power of attorney legalized by the Egyptian Consulate in the director's home country, combined with original or consultant-authenticated board resolutions delegating signatory authority and a physical attendance by the appointed local agent.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inconsistent source-of-funds or source-of-wealth for initial capital injection and subsequent shareholder advances from an offshore holding entity.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Audited financial statements of the LLC and shareholder, personal/entity net-worth statement, bank reference letters, underlying corporate bank statements showing the funds trail, board resolutions approving the capital structure, notarized passports and shareholder ledger extracts, and consular-legalized corporate registration certificates.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unclear beneficial-ownership chain on a 100% foreign-owned Egyptian LLC, particularly where the UBO resides in a GCC or offshore jurisdiction.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete UBO register, organizational chart, certificate of registration in the foreign jurisdiction, shareholders' ledger, nominee disclosure forms, and an independent AML risk assessment prepared by a licensed compliance consultancy; any sanctions/PEP hits must be accompanied by a written explanatory memorandum and professional negative screening report.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Payment-rail red flag: high-frequency cross-border invoicing to overseas clients under the 6920 accounting-services code without matching tax and contract records.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed client engagements, service delivery evidence, statutory invoices, matched transaction history, Egyptian Tax Authority card (Bataqa Daribia), VAT registration certificates, and a sanctions/PEP screening report evidencing no adverse jurisdictions.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant protocol: the foreign shareholder wires capital from its home bank via SWIFT MT103 with the narrative 'Equity contribution to EG_LLC under Law 159/1981' to the CBE-designated capital escrow account at the chosen Egyptian bank. The receiving bank must receive a copy of the LLC's memorandum and articles, the capital deposit certificate issued by a local notary or bank, the commercial registration extract, the tax card, and a signed CBE foreign-financing declaration. Shareholder loans creating external indebtedness must be pre-registered to satisfy CBE debt monitoring and repatriation requirements.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Operating disbursements use standard SWIFT MT103/MT202 transfers; larger trade settlements are executed through sight or usance Commercial Letters of Credit under UCPDC 600. For service exports under the fractional CFO model, outbound settlements of vendor invoices are cleared after submission of the underlying contract, beneficiary invoice, VAT/tax compliance certificate, and, where the payment is linked to import/export flows, CBE Form A documentation.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Plain-vanilla deliverable FX forwards between EGP and USD/EUR with a licensed Egyptian bank, limited to underlying trade or service-exposure maturities of up to 365 days.
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on EGP/USD executed offshore for cash-settled currency-risk management without breaching onshore banking restrictions.
FX swaps between EGP and hard currencies offered by CBE-licensed banks, subject to documentation of an eligible current-account or capital-account transaction.
Cross-currency swaps matching an underlying external debt facility or material export receivable, executed only with a CBE-authorized counterparty and subject to CBE derivative-reporting circulars.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate Income Tax Return (Form No. 2) and audited annual financial statements for the fiscal year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) pursuant to Income Tax Law No. 91/2005 and Executive Regulations
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 30 April of the calendar year following the fiscal year end; for a 31 December year-end, due by 30 April of the next year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty: EGP 50 per day up to EGP 5,000 per month; additional tax delay charge of 1.5% per month (or fraction) on unpaid tax; risk of administrative seizure for persistent non-filing

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual audited balance sheet and profit and loss statement filed with the General Authority for Investment (GAFI) corporate registry record
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) under Companies Law No. 159/1981 as amended by Law No. 4/2018 and Executive Regulation No. 96/2018
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within six months of the end of the financial year; mandatory filing no later than 30 June for a 31 December year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing fines of EGP 1,000 to EGP 10,000; repeated default may trigger GAFI administrative warning, legal referral, and an initiative toward compulsory strike-off for non-compliance with annual registration obligations

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Tax Card renewal application and fee payment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) commercial registry tax card unit under Law No. 91/2005 and Ministerial procedures
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Renewal due on or before 31 January of each calendar year; grace period extends to end of February with late fee
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal penalty of EGP 500 for the first 30 days, escalating EGP 1,000 thereafter; non-renewal is an administrative obstacle for customs clearance, banking operations, and tender participation

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Confirmation of Beneficial Ownership Register (UBO) filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: GAFI Beneficial Ownership Unit, in accordance with AML Law No. 80/2002 and GAFI UBO Register regulations (2020/2021)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after the Annual General Meeting approving annual financial statements; an update also required within 30 days of any ownership or control change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines from EGP 2,000 to EGP 20,000 per violation and possible suspension of the LLC's commercial registration; willful false declaration may trigger criminal liability under AML Article 60

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Withholding Tax Annual Summary Reconciliation (for payments to non-residents and dividend distributions)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) - Withholding Tax and Tax Returns Department
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after the end of April of the year following the fiscal year; must match quarterly withholding declarations
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Default of 1.5% per month on unreported withholding amounts plus a punitive fine of 25% of tax due if false declarations; exposure to anti-evasion remedies

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: All Egyptian limited liability companies, irrespective of revenue, assets, or member count, are legally required to appoint a licensed accountant auditor registered with the Egyptian Accountants and Auditors Syndicate and ETA; Statutory Law No. 4/2018 mandates an independent audit for every LLC and filing of the auditor's report with GAFI.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Egyptian Accounting Standards (EAS) issued by the Ministry of Finance Decree No. 110/2015, substantially aligned with IFRS; legal entities must prepare financial statements under EAS for ETA and GAFI.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The LLC must record natural person beneficial owners with direct or indirect ownership above 25%, or exercising ultimate control. Annual confirmation is submitted via GAFI's electronic registry after the AGM approving annual accounts; changes in shareholding or control require UBO register update within 30 days. The register is not public and is inspected by GAFI, the Financial Red and the Egyptian Financial Intelligence Unit upon request; violations carry pecuniary fines and potential listing against the LLC.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute Book of General Assembly Resolutions

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Free-zone entities may benefit from 0% tax relief on certain activities; small and micro enterprises under Law 152/2020 with annual turnover up to EGP 20 million may apply simplified turnover-based tax at 0.5%–1%; additional deductions for research, development, and labor-intensive sectors may lower effective tax; investment incentives under Law 72/2017.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form No. 116 (Corporate Tax Return) – Egyptian Tax Authority e-filing portal (eta.gov.eg)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within four months of the end of the fiscal year, unless a specific extension is obtained from the Egyptian Tax Authority

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross revenues or total turnover from Egyptian sources
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report only Egyptian-source revenues; foreign-source income is taxable only if attributable to an Egyptian permanent establishment.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cost of sales and direct expenses
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Deduct only expenses connected with Egyptian-source income; allocate overhead using an arm's length method.
Apply Egyptian tax accounting rules; intercompany management fees must be supported by transfer pricing documentation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net taxable income before loss carry-forward
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Compute only under Law No. 91 of 2005; foreign accounting adjustments are not automatically accepted.
Utilize only losses within the five-year carryforward period and where the entity continues the same activity.
Enter zero if negative; no negative tax is payable.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Corporate income tax at statutory rate
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply 22.5% unless a treaty or special regime is claimed; attach a computation schedule.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Advance tax payments and foreign tax credits
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Claim provisional payments made during the year; foreign tax credits are limited to amounts attributable to Egyptian-source income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Withholding taxes and other creditable taxes
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach valid Tax Residency Certificate and treaty relief forms before crediting any Egyptian withholding tax.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: monthly delay tax of 2% of unpaid tax (capped at 8%), plus fixed non-filing fine up to EGP 50,000; late payment interest of 2% per month (capped at 8%); deliberate false filing or evasion incurs criminal penalties including imprisonment up to five years and fines.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: The non-resident recipient must submit a valid Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) for the relevant year, a Form WHT-1 treaty relief claim, and a beneficial ownership declaration. The Egyptian payor withholds at the base 10% rate; the Egyptian Tax Authority International Taxation Department grants reduced treaty rates (commonly 5%–10%) either by pre-clearance or refund.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: statutory 20% withholding for non-resident recipients; treaty rates commonly 10%–15%. Interest: statutory 20% withholding on Egyptian-sourced debt interest; treaty rates commonly 5%–10%, with exemptions for certain government and banking interest.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: EGP 5,000,000 aggregate controlled transactions in a tax year for the Local File; Master File generally required for groups with worldwide consolidated revenues exceeding EGP 100,000,000.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Egypt does not operate a separate Economic Substance Regulations regime, but general anti-avoidance rules under Law 91/2005 require genuine economic activity, beneficial ownership, and substance to maintain domicile and treaty benefits. A shell company lacking employees, premises, bank activity, or independent management may be re-characterized and stripped of tax treaty access.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Suppression of revenue, falsifying ledgers, using unreported offshore accounts, or intentionally omitting taxable Egyptian-source income from Form 116.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Penalty of 100%–200% of the evaded tax, imprisonment up to five years, and forced collection through attachment of bank accounts and movable assets.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly file false returns are jointly and severally personally liable for the tax; travel bans may be issued, and under Egyptian criminal tax provisions offenders risk imprisonment in addition to civil restitution.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell company / Artificial arrangement / Lack of substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Establishing an Egyptian LLC solely for tax treaty avoidance, with no real office, no employees, no management activity outside nominees, and no economic nexus in Egypt.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Re-characterization of the entity, denial of treaty relief, imposition of 22.5% corporate tax on deemed Egyptian-source income, plus additional penalties of up to 100% of the tax due; possible striking-off from the commercial registry.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and shareholders who orchestrate the shell may be held personally liable for corporate tax debts; courts may lift the corporate veil and impose travel bans and imprisonment for deliberate abuse.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to maintain a beneficial ownership register, absence of client due diligence when using third-party payment rails such as Stripe or Wise, or executing transfers with unknown counterparties without AML screening.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines up to EGP 200,000 per violation under Egypt's AML Law (Law No. 80 of 2002 as amended), suspension or revocation of the operating license, and confiscation of linked funds.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may face criminal prosecution for knowingly enabling money-laundering or circumventing AML controls; sanctions include imprisonment up to two years, personal fines, asset freezes, and travel bans pending judicial proceedings.
